errors.text: The proposed SRO-controlled nucleation mechanism directly contradicts the target result that dislocations nucleate at vacancy clusters or locally disordered atoms.

No cited evidence demonstrates SRO-controlled Shockley-partial nucleation or reduced stacking-fault energy in bulk FCC equiatomic FeNiCrMn; the references concern different alloys, crystal structures, properties, or nanowire geometries.
The baseline assumes free-surface nucleation and isotropic yielding, whereas the target is a periodic bulk single crystal with pronounced orientation-dependent yield strength.
